tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates unnecessary server redirects on every visitor click, speeding up navigation.
sampleUrls: https://oh-deer.com/locations/ [Footer location query links missing trailing slashes]
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. Open Master Workbook Sheet 'Internal 301 Redirects (245)': https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fmY7Y1su8nK8_t_nGC400_Pk3LK6greu/edit?gid=603582706#gid=603582706
